grants.description: BIPARTISAN INFRASTRUCTURE LAW (BIL): MINNESOTA POWER HIGH-VOLTAGE DIRECT CURRENT (HVDC) TERMINATION EXPANSION CAPABILITY (HTEC) PROJECT.
